name: Adoni-bezek
summary: A Canaanite king defeated at Bezek; Judah cuts off his thumbs and big toes, and he dies in Jerusalem admitting it is fitting payback for what he did to seventy other kings.

name: Caleb
summary: One of the twelve spies who gave a faithful report of Canaan; he offers his daughter Achsah in marriage to whoever captures Kiriath-sepher.

name: Othniel
summary: Caleb's younger relative who captures Kiriath-sepher and marries Achsah, then becomes Israel's first judge, delivering the nation from Cushan-rishathaim.

name: Achsah
summary: Caleb's daughter, given in marriage to Othniel after he captures Kiriath-sepher; she asks her father for springs of water to go with her land.

name: Ehud
summary: A left-handed Benjaminite judge who assassinates Moab's king Eglon with a hidden sword and then leads Israel to defeat the Moabite army at the Jordan.

name: Eglon
summary: The obese king of Moab who oppresses Israel for eighteen years until Ehud assassinates him in his upper room.

name: Shamgar
summary: A judge who kills six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad and saves Israel.

name: Deborah
summary: A prophetess and judge who holds court under a palm tree in Ephraim's hill country and summons Barak to fight Sisera.

name: Barak
summary: The commander Deborah summons to lead Israel's army against Sisera; he agrees only if Deborah goes with him.

name: Sisera
summary: The commander of King Jabin's army and its nine hundred iron chariots; he flees the battle on foot and is killed by Jael.

name: Jabin
summary: The Canaanite king of Hazor whose commander Sisera oppresses Israel for twenty years.

name: Jael
summary: The wife of Heber the Kenite who shelters the fleeing Sisera in her tent and kills him with a tent peg while he sleeps.

name: Gideon
summary: A reluctant deliverer from Manasseh whom the angel of the LORD calls to save Israel from Midian; he defeats Midian's army with three hundred men and refuses to be made king.

name: Gideon's Three Hundred
summary: The three hundred men selected because they lapped water like dogs, who rout Midian's camp at night with trumpets, jars, and torches.

name: Zebah
summary: One of the two Midianite kings Gideon pursues, captures, and executes for killing his brothers at Tabor.

name: Zalmunna
summary: One of the two Midianite kings Gideon pursues, captures, and executes for killing his brothers at Tabor.

name: Abimelech
summary: Gideon's son by a Shechemite concubine; he murders his seventy brothers to become king over Shechem and dies at Thebez when a woman drops a millstone on his head.

name: Jotham
summary: Gideon's youngest son, the only brother to escape Abimelech's massacre; he tells the fable of the trees and curses Abimelech and Shechem.

name: Jephthah
summary: A Gileadite outcast, son of a prostitute, recruited by Gilead's elders to lead Israel against Ammon; his rash vow costs his only daughter's life.

name: Jephthah's Daughter
summary: Jephthah's only child, who greets him with tambourines after his victory over Ammon and is sacrificed to fulfill his vow.

name: Manoah
summary: A Danite from Zorah whose barren wife is visited by the angel of the LORD; he offers a sacrifice on which the angel ascends.

name: Manoah's Wife
summary: Manoah's barren wife, told by the angel of the LORD that she will bear Samson; she reasons that the LORD would not have accepted their offering if he meant to kill them.

name: Samson
summary: A Nazirite from birth whose great strength comes from his uncut hair; he judges Israel twenty years and dies pulling down the temple of Dagon on the Philistines.

name: Delilah
summary: A woman from the Valley of Sorek paid by the Philistine lords to discover the secret of Samson's strength; she has his hair cut after he tells her the truth.

name: Micah
summary: An Ephraimite who builds a household shrine with idols made from his mother's silver and hires a wandering Levite as his priest, until the tribe of Dan takes both.

name: Micah's Levite Priest
summary: A young Levite from Bethlehem hired by Micah as his household priest; he leaves with the tribe of Dan when they offer to make him priest to an entire tribe.

name: The Levite of Ephraim
summary: A Levite from Ephraim's hill country whose concubine is abused and killed at Gibeah; he cuts her body into twelve pieces and sends them throughout Israel.

name: The Levite's Concubine
summary: The Levite's concubine from Bethlehem, whose abuse and death at the hands of the men of Gibeah leads Israel to war against the tribe of Benjamin.

name: The People of Israel
summary: The assembled tribes of Israel, who gather at Mizpah to hear the Levite's account and demand Gibeah's guilty men be handed over.
